title: ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn
summary: Whether this ScreenGui is destroyed and re-copied from StarterGui at each respawn (default TRUE). Persistent HUDs must set it false — or they vanish every death.

properties.name: ResetOnSpawn
properties.description: When true, the engine removes this ScreenGui from PlayerGui and re-copies it from StarterGui on respawn — destroying runtime state.

explanation.whatItIs: The 'does my UI die with me?' switch.
explanation.whyItExists: Some GUIs should reset per life (death screens), others must survive (HUDs, inventory).
whenToUse: false: HUDs, inventories, minimaps — anything persistent
true: per-life screens you want freshly re-copied
whenNotToUse: Leaving the default for persistent UI — that's the bug
tips: Runtime-created ScreenGuis default true too — set it explicitly
commonMistakes: 'My HUD disappears when I die' → ResetOnSpawn was true
Rebuilding state after every respawn instead of fixing the property

examples.title: Persistent vs per-life GUIs
examples.code:
local hud = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
hud.Name = "HUD"
hud.ResetOnSpawn = false    -- survives deaths
hud.Parent = playerGui

local deathScreen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
deathScreen.Name = "DeathScreen"
deathScreen.ResetOnSpawn = true   -- fresh copy each life (default)
deathScreen.Enabled = false
deathScreen.Parent = playerGui
